notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Nmap UDP scan against port 623 with ipmi-version NSE fingerprints the IPMI version, BMC vendor, and firmware version. Confirms IPMI presence before attempting the RAKP hash dump.

=== CHAINING ===
nmap -sU -p 623 → ipmi-version NSE → if IPMI 2.0 confirmed → msf ipmi_dumphashes → hashcat → password reuse testing.

=== BMC VENDORS ===
HP iLO, Dell iDRAC, Supermicro IPMI each have known default credentials to test first. Version fingerprint also enables vendor-specific CVE lookup.
